openings.claim: Test whether stale notes cause second searches independently of rack-type ambiguity.
openings.discriminator: Stale notes with unambiguous cards predict failures; ambiguity despite current notes favors the rival. Failures with current, unambiguous records weaken both.
openings.probe: On 20 stipulated requests, anonymously record witnessed currency, ambiguity and first-lookup success on existing paper. Unwitnessed currency stays unknown; add no diagnostic lookup. Withhold uncertain erasers; count unresolved or withheld delivery as failures.
openings.uncertainty: Separate synthetic totals establish neither overlap nor causation. Recording within clerk duties and enough witnessed movements are unverified; intervention benefit remains unproven.

openings.claim: Bind each card home rack to a current temporary-location override in one paper row, updated on movement and return, yielding location and return rack together.
openings.discriminator: Compare separate baseline, cards alone, notes alone and maintained hybrid. Under identical requests and update opportunities, removing only the keyed override should selectively worsen temporary-location resolution; identical unbound-adjacent performance weakens interaction.
openings.probe: Dry-run the same 20 stipulated requests, movements and returns across comparisons. Count lookups, wrong handoffs and indicated return-rack correctness. Accurate bindings requiring second lookups or wrong handoffs defeat predicted performance.
openings.uncertainty: Temporary-location verification, timely updates and adequate type identification are assumptions; no outcome is asserted.

lineage.reason: Causal hypothesis retained with its rival and defeat conditions.
Keyed interaction, parent comparison and return relation retained.
Independent currency, unknowns and delivery failures qualify the hypothesis.

decision: Use existing clerk, rack/cards, paper and pencil only; no purchases or borrower names. Diagnose causes before claiming benefit. Evaluate at most one lookup and zero wrong handoffs separately from correct delivery and return. This is an unscored synthetic preflight, not field evidence.
